course_outcomes: CO1: Determine the rank of a matrix to investigate the existence and uniqueness of solutions, identify and analyse system behaviour under different conditions.
CO2: Apply fundamental principles of Eigen values, Eigen vectors, diagonalization and quadratic forms, enabling the analysis and interpretation of basic engineering problems.
CO3: Apply fundamental concepts such as partial derivatives, chain rule, local linear approximations and optimization techniques to analyse and solve problems involving functions of two variables.
CO4: Compute multiple integrals and apply them to find areas and volumes of geometrical shapes, mass and centre of gravity of plane laminas.
CO5: Describe functions using various series expansions such as Taylor series, Binomial series and Fourier series.
